title: WordInferBench: Can Agents Infer How to Edit from Word Document Context?
abstract: arXiv:2611.15189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Document editing is among the most common knowledge-work tasks, yet existing benchmarks for evaluating autonomous agents on Word document editing provide fully specified attribute-modification instructions. They do not evaluate agents' ability to infer the appropriate attributes from document context, a capability essential in real-world editing where users expect consistency without spelling out every attribute. We introduce WordInferBench, a benchmark comprising 280 base document-editing instances, each paired with three instruction conditions: descriptive (the instruction explicitly lists every attribute change), referential (the instruction points to another object as an exemplar), and inferential (the agent must examine document context to infer what attributes to apply). translated_title: WordInferBench：智能体能否从 Word 文档上下文中推断出如何编辑？
translated_abstract: 文档编辑是最常见的知识型工作任务之一，然而现有用于评估自主智能体 Word 文档编辑能力的基准测试，都提供了完整指定属性修改内容的指令。它们并未评估智能体从文档上下文中推断适当属性的能力，而这种能力在现实编辑场景中至关重要——用户期望文档保持一致性，却不会逐条说明每个属性。我们提出了 WordInferBench，这是一个包含 280 个基础文档编辑实例的基准测试，每个实例配有三种指令条件：描述型（指令明确列出每一项属性更改）、指代型（指令指向另一个对象作为范例）和推断型（智能体必须查看文档上下文来推断应应用的属性）。为了评估上下文属性推断能力，每个基础实例的构建方式都确保目标格式可以从文档内的范例中恢复得出。这些实例……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 WordInferBench 基准，通过描述型、指代型和推断型三种指令条件共 280 个文档编辑实例，评估智能体能否从 Word 文档上下文中推断出应修改的格式属性。
en_tdlr: WordInferBench is a benchmark of 280 document-editing instances under descriptive, referential, and inferential instruction conditions that evaluates whether agents can infer which formatting attributes to modify from Word document context.
